name: inFlow Inventory
description_en:
inFlow Inventory is a product in the Inventory management category. Its directory profile covers Transfer Management, Traceability, Supplier Management, Shipping Management, Serialized Inventory Tracking, Purchase Order Management, Order Entry, Kitting.

Additional listed capabilities include Inventory Overview, Inventory Optimization, Inventory Forecasting, Custom Pricing Models, Cost Tracking, Barcoding (RFID), Search and Filter, Multi-Location. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $89.0. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: maintain supplier information and operational records; organize shipment preparation and related records; prepare and track purchase orders; coordinate stock locations and warehouse tasks. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
inFlow Inventory 属于库存管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括传输管理、可追溯性、供应商管理、发货管理、序列号库存跟踪、采购订单管理、订单录入、套件组装管理。

资料还列出库存概览、库存优化、库存预测、自定义定价模式、成本跟踪、条码与 RFID、搜索与筛选、多地点管理。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS) 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $89.0. 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：维护供应商资料与业务记录；组织发货准备和相关记录；创建并跟踪采购订单；协调库存位置与仓库作业。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
